title: Prime-power coefficient presentations and canonical quotient maps
statement: For natural numbers $\ell,r$, write $R_{\ell,r}=\operatorname{ULift}_u(\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z)$ and $A_{\ell,r}=\operatorname{ULift}_{u+1}(R_{\ell,r})$, with their transported commutative ring structures. Here $\mathbf Z/0\mathbf Z$ means $\mathbf Z$, and the lifts only change size. For natural numbers $m\le r$, define $q_{\ell,r,m}:A_{\ell,r}\to A_{\ell,m}$ to be the twice-lifted canonical quotient ring homomorphism induced by $\ell^m\mid\ell^r$, sending the class of every integer to its class modulo $\ell^m$. For prime $\ell$ and positive levels these are the coefficient rings $\Lambda_r=\mathbf Z/\ell^r\mathbf Z$ and the coefficient reduction maps, expressed in the module universe.
